name: elagoht/analytics
description: A collage plugin that adds an analytics snippet to every page's head.

config.description: A collage plugin that adds an analytics snippet to every page's head.

exclude.description: Exclude are names of pages that get no snippet: an admin page, a page behind a login.

code.description: Code is the site's code: "mysite" counts at mysite.goatcounter.com.

endpoint.description: Endpoint is the count URL, for a self-hosted server: "https://stats.example.com/count". Default from Code.

script.description: Script is the script's URL. Default "https://gc.zgo.at/count.js".

googleAnalytics.description: GoogleAnalytics is Google Analytics 4. It sets cookies and sends what it collects to Google: it is not privacy-friendly, and in much of the world it needs the visitor's consent — see RequireConsent.

loaderPath.description: LoaderPath is where the plugin's loader script is served, when there is one: with RespectDNT, RequireConsent or Google Analytics. Default "/collage-analytics.js".

domain.description: Domain is the site as Plausible knows it: "example.com". Several, comma-separated, send each view to each.

script.description: Script is the script's URL, for a self-hosted server or one of Plausible's script variants. Default "https://plausible.io/js/script.js".

requireConsent.description: RequireConsent loads nothing until the page calls window.collageAnalyticsConsent(). The site shows its own banner and calls it when the visitor agrees; the answer is remembered in localStorage, and collageAnalyticsConsent(false) forgets it.

respectDnt.description: RespectDNT loads nothing for a browser sending Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control. The check runs in the browser, before any provider's script is fetched; a page cached for everyone cannot make it on the server.

script.description: Script is the script's URL. Default "https://cloud.umami.is/script.js".

websiteId.description: WebsiteID is the site's id, a UUID.
